product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount for Large Screen Portrait and Landscape Display Fits 55 to 86 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Column Mount for Large Screen Portrait and Landscape Display, Fits 55" to 86" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Column Mount is designed for mounting a single large, landscape or portrait-oriented display directly to a structural column or pillar. It supports 55" to 86" TVs, provides adjustable tilt for viewing optimization, and offers a clean alternative to wall or floor-based mounting in open commercial spaces. This mount is well suited for lobbies, concourses, retail floors, and venues where floor space must remain clear and displays need prominent placement.Attaches directly to structural columns, freeing floor space while keeping displays at eye-catching positionsSupports 55" to 86" displays with a maximum load capacity of 155 lbs (70 kgs)Compatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mm for broad display compatibilityFixed tilt positions up to 15° for viewer-optimized display anglesIdeal for lobbies, concourses, and open retail floors where walls are unavailable or obstructiveSingle-display landscape configuration for feature signage, wayfinding, and advertisingSteel construction with included fasteners for rigidity and long-term stabilityDesigned for indoor commercial use; professional installation recommended COLUMN MOUNTED DESIGN FOR SPACE EFFICIENT INSTALLATIONSThe mount is engineered for direct attachment to structural columns, allowing displays to be installed in locations where walls are unavailable or floor mounts would obstruct traffic. This approach preserves open floor areas while keeping screens at eye-catching positions. SUPPORTS EXTRA LARGE PORTRAIT AND LANDSCAPE DISPLAYSSupports 55" to 86" displays with a maximum load capacity of 155 lbs (70 kgs) per screen, making it suitable for large-format signage, wayfinding, and advertising displays. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR VIEWING OPTIMIZATIONThe mounting interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to optimize viewing angles based on mounting height and audience position. BROAD VESA COMPATIBILITYSupports VESA mounting patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mm, covering the majority of large commercial flat panel displays. COMMERCIAL GRADE CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction with included fasteners provides rigidity and stability for indoor commercial installations.
